data.body: AC amendment (gap analysis #1): dd-3 re-query must RECONSTRUCT the full sg invocation — the marker's detection_query is a BARE ast-grep pattern (e.g. legacy_call($$$)) with NO --lang and NO path, and lang is NOT recorded in the marker. The test must: (a) extract detection_query from the marker JSON; (b) supply --lang python explicitly (hardcode/pin — unrecoverable from marker); (c) pass the swept-copy path: sg --pattern "<detection_query>" --lang python <swept_tree>. Do NOT assume detection_query is directly runnable.
